name: bvb-geometry-appearance-075
geometry_source: central-view LingBot pose and sparse depth
appearance_source: DINOv2 features from expanded detection crops of the same category
score_rule: g + appearance_weight * s * (1 - g) if g >= geometry_gate else g
recommended_scope_for_reproduction: Filter to the target category's observations before peak grouping. This filter is applied to the input, separately from the scoring parameters.
